summary: Verified prerender fail-safe fix. Static build/: index.html (96KB) has 'Rates verified Oct 25, 2026', 36 APY occurrences, 11 'Marcus' mentions, exactly 1 <title> and 1 meta description. best-1-year-cd-rates (26 APY) and best-cd-rates (85 APY) have unique titles (1 each). 404.html contains 404; sitemap.xml has 36 <loc> + 36 <lastmod>. Fresh staging pipeline (yarn build --outDir build-staging + PRERENDER_DIR=build-staging node prerender.mjs) reported 'Prerendered 38/38 routes', exit 0, 0 failed routes, staged index.html had 36 APY + Rates verified date; build-staging cleaned up, build/ untouched. daily-refresh.sh logic reviewed: correct. Backend /api/rates regression passes (34 rates, updated_at, oldest_updated_at). Frontend: home shows 'Rates verified Oct 25, 2026', 10 Open Account buttons, clicking opens lead dialog (not submitted).

issues: Cookie consent banner (bottom-center) overlaps the bottom of the Open Account modal (submit button area/privacy note) until accepted/declined - pre-existing, minor

action_items: Optional: swap in daily-refresh.sh is two mv's (build->build.bak, build-staging->build) leaving a ms-scale window with no build/; for true atomicity consider symlinked release dirs (ln -sfn + mv -T)
Optional: cookie banner z-index/position vs lead modal
critical_code_review_comments: daily-refresh.sh: set -euo pipefail ensures prerender non-zero exit (piped through tail) aborts before swap; APY grep is an extra guard; build.bak preserved. Logic correct.
Sanity grep checks only index.html; other routes rely on prerender's per-route waitForSelector + exit 1 - acceptable.
prerender.mjs: PRERENDER_DIR honored; rateRoutes wait for [data-testid^='open-account-'] with 20s timeout and route counted as failed otherwise -> process.exit(1). Correct.
Note: sitemap is written even when routes fail (before exit 1) - harmless since staging dir is discarded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skipped test_verify_all, test_patch_and_restore, test_chat in regression to avoid mutating rate stamps/LLM calls. Did not run verify-run or submit leads. Prerender takes ~2 min.
